[b][size=5]
First of all, thank you guys for enjoying my mod. It's good to make friends around the world only with my hobby. I'm grateful to everyone who is cheering and supporting me. This makes me keep my passion and happiness stable.[/size][/b]

[u][size=4][b]


Now, I have some words with people who hated my mod and some try to command me:[/b][/size]
[/u]
[i][size=4] [b]+) If you are a hater[/b], that's fine. Everyone has their taste. Maybe my work disrespects you and you feel offended about it. I sincerely apologize if my mod has anything concerning you. But you can't attack people with words because you don't like them. The shot from the gun can miss but the shot from the mouth can't.[/size]
[size=4]Maybe you find it funny since the guy makes NSFW content talk about politeness. Yes, I do. If you offend people you are wrong, it's like you criticize their hobbies, so what will happen if your hobby gets criticized? Is that cool to criticize someone's thing? I don't think so.[/size][/i]

[size=4][i][b]+)[/b]  [b]If you are people who like to take the rein from me[/b], ask me directly to give you or make some specific mod then you're at the wrong place, I don't take any request and I won't unless it takes my intention. I'm just one of a thousand modders who can't satisfy you so you better find another modder who is willing to work for you unconditionally. Please remember that everyone is human, not your tools. If you find it offensive then you can leave, I can't deal with people who didn't respect the modder and all the work they had done.[/i][/size]

[size=4][b][i][u]To sum this up, next time if you 2 types of guys above see my mod, please ignore it and we'll have a good day.[/u][/i][/b][/size]
[size=4] 
[b][i][u]Please remember my opinion is not willing to cause swearing/violence or any social problem under any circumstance.[/u][/i][/b]

[b]Once again, thank you everyone for reading this.[/b][/size][b]
[/b]
